main_measure.name: mean excess 10-bar return, new-high (prox=1) minus other in-regime grid cases
main_measure.threshold: Welch t >= 2 (with correlation > 0) confirms; Welch t <= -2 rejects; at least 30 grid cases per group

supporting_check.name: correlation of prox with excess 10-bar return across in-regime grid cases

decided_by: Welch t lies between -2 and 2 (inconclusive rule).
reading: In-regime grid cases are grid bars (positions 0,10,20,... of each window) with a recorded prox value; new-high means prox equal to 1 within 1e-9; the coin's mean 10-bar return is taken over the same non-overlapping grid of all its windows; for bars with fewer than 28 in-window bars of history the situation check uses the recorded regime ('trending').
